summary: E2E tested the new Admin > Publicité (Ads) tab. Backend endpoints (/api/ads/campaigns GET/POST/DELETE and /api/ads/summary) return correct data with auth. Frontend UI flow verified: admin login → /admin → 'Publicité' tab loads AdsPanel with KPI cards and empty state; creating a campaign (TEST_Campaign_Google, google, budget 1000, spend 500, leads 25, revenue 3000) adds a row and updates KPIs correctly (Dépense 500€, Budget 1000€, Leads 25, CPL 20€, ROAS 6×); deleting the campaign (via window.confirm auto-accepted) removes the row, restores empty state and resets KPIs to 0/—. Test campaign was cleaned up.

issues: Delete confirmation uses native window.confirm() instead of a shadcn AlertDialog — inconsistent with the rest of the admin UI and cannot be styled/tested via data-testid. Consider replacing with AlertDialog for consistency.

action_items: Optional: replace window.confirm() in AdsPanel delete flow with a shadcn AlertDialog for UX consistency and easier E2E testing.
critical_code_review_comments: AdsPanel uses window.confirm — not consistent with the rest of the admin surface which uses AlertDialog; also blocks tests without a page.on('dialog') handler.

All required data-testids are present and stable (ads-panel, ads-new-btn, ads-name, ads-platform, ads-budget, ads-spend, ads-leads, ads-revenue, ads-save, ads-kpis, ads-list, ads-empty, ads-row-<id>, ads-del-<id>).
seed_data_creation: Created one test campaign 'TEST_Campaign_Google' during the test and deleted it at the end — DB is clean.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Ads module fully green. KPI math verified (CPL = spend/leads, ROAS = revenue/spend). Only cosmetic remark: delete uses window.confirm; Playwright must register page.on('dialog', lambda d: d.accept()) to test delete.
